candidates.lead: Commission is taxed as ordinary income in Australia: it is added to salary and taxed at the marginal rate under the 2026-27 brackets, so there is no separate commission tax rate. On an $80,000 salary a $5,000 commission adds $1,600 to the year's tax, 32.0% of the commission including the 2% Medicare levy [[bonusTaxSplit]]. The employer withholds from the commission pay under ATO Schedule 5.

Tax on commission in Australia is the extra income tax the payment adds to the year, worked out at the marginal rate on the 2026-27 scale because commission is ordinary income. A $5,000 commission on top of an $80,000 salary costs $1,600 in tax and Medicare levy, 32.0% of it [[bonusTaxSplit]]. Employer withholding on the commission pay follows ATO Schedule 5 and is reconciled at tax time.

A commission tax calculator separates two figures: the tax a commission adds to the year's assessment, and the PAYG amount the employer withholds from the commission pay under ATO Schedule 5. Both use the 2026-27 rates; for example, $5,000 of commission on an $80,000 salary adds $1,600 of tax and Medicare levy for the year [[bonusTaxSplit]], and any difference from the withheld amount is settled as a refund or bill.
